* DeleteResponderBase represents all states after IKE_INIT and IKE_AUTH. * *

All post-init states share common functionality of being able to respond to IKE_DELETE * requests.

methods.name: protected IkeMessage buildIkeDeleteResp(IkeMessage req, IkeSaRecord ikeSaRecord)
methods.comment: Builds a IKE Delete Response for the given IKE SA and request.

methods.name: protected void validateIkeDeleteReq(IkeMessage req, IkeSaRecord expectedRecord) throws InvalidSyntaxException
methods.comment:
* Validates that the delete request is acceptable. * *

The request message must be guaranteed by previous checks to be of SUBTYPE_DELETE_IKE, * and therefore contains an IkeDeletePayload. This is checked in getIkeExchangeSubType.

methods.name: protected void handleDeleteSessionRequest(IkeMessage ikeMessage)
methods.comment:
* Helper method for responding to a session deletion request * *

Note that this method expects that the session is keyed on the current IKE SA session, * and closing the IKE SA indicates that the remote wishes to end the session as a whole. As * such, this should not be used in rekey cases where there is any ambiguity as to which IKE * SA the session is reliant upon. * *

Note that this method will also quit the state machine. * * @param ikeMessage The received session deletion request
